label: Translate
depicts: Letter A shape under one short top bar with one crossing character stroke on the left
use_when: Use when the interface wants translation to read as a language symbol built from letters and character strokes.
avoid_when: Do not use for the framed translate icon when the mark should not rely on a plus cross inside an open square frame.

label: Tv
depicts: Rectangular screen with one short center stand under the lower edge
use_when: Use when the interface wants the television to read as a clean flat screen resting on one short stand.
avoid_when: Do not use for the antenna television when the screen should show two prongs rising from the top edge.

label: Tv
depicts: Rectangular screen with two antenna prongs rising from the top edge
use_when: Use when the interface wants the television to feel more like a classic set with antenna prongs on top.
avoid_when: Do not use for the flat screen stand when the display should not have prongs growing from the top edge.

label: Ufo
depicts: Flying saucer with one round dome on top of one flat oval base
use_when: Use when the interface wants a clean front facing saucer without tilt or beam dots below it.
avoid_when: Do not use for the tilted ufo when the craft should angle to one side and trail small beam dots below.

label: Ufo
depicts: Tilted flying saucer with one round dome and three small beam dots falling below
use_when: Use when the interface wants the ufo to feel in motion with a tilted body and beam dots below.
avoid_when: Do not use for the upright saucer when the craft should face front and avoid the falling beam dots.
